scope: Test whether bulk dielectric stabilization, specific methanol hydrogen bonding, or a change in transition identity explains the three-solvent response of phenolate dyes 3 and 4. Separate substituent and solvent effects with a held-out methanol prediction and a stoichiometrically matched micro-solvation control.

controls.holdout: Freeze continuum method, state-matching rule, broadening and any global offset from toluene/ethyl acetate before revealing methanol error. This is a retrospective holdout, not a claim that source observations were unseen.
controls.cluster_definition: For each dye add exactly one neutral methanol. Initialize phenolate O···H-O(MeOH) hydrogen-bonded placement at O···H=1.8 Å and a remote placement with methanol O at least 5 Å from every dye heteroatom; optimize independently in methanol continuum. Distance is an initialization, not a presumed minimum. If both collapse to one basin, retain trajectory evidence and use a remote constrained single point as the non-H-bond electronic control, not an equilibrium species.
controls.atom_mapping: Dye+MeOH graph is the disconnected union with unique maps. Retain the dye common phenolate-imine-phenylene subgraph between dyes; ring replacement atoms are explicitly unmatched.

source_notes: Main PDF p2 structure figure identifies terminal rings; pp3–4 solvent response and computational method.
SI pp3–5 distinguish two bands and provide solvent observations.
molecular_boundary: Dye3 and dye4 differ by a terminal nitrothiophene versus nitrophenyl group. They are not positional isomers and do not share an elemental formula. Retain the E imine, q=-1 singlet and no counterion. Three solvents cannot locate a continuous inversion point or support a four-parameter Catalan fit. Molecular spectra do not establish bulk ion-pair or device behavior. All required comparisons are core; the optional extension listed below is not a completion condition. A documented failure is a valid submission but is not scientific completion. Evidence-supported collapse of an initialized basin, or inability to distinguish explanations after completing the core matrix, is scientifically admissible. An unattempted core comparison cannot be replaced by an uncertainty statement.
optional_not_required: A comprehensive solvent library and kinetic lifetimes are outside scope.
